gloss: information board; guide board; directory sign

definitions.gloss: information board; guide board; directory sign
definitions.explanation: A board or sign that provides directions, maps, or information to visitors. Commonly found at stations, parks, tourist spots, and public buildings.

examples.japanese: {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}を{確認|かくにん}する。
{駅前|えきまえ}に{大|おお}きな{案内|あんない}{板|ばん}がある。
examples.english: There is a large information board in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}の{地図|ちず}を{見|み}て、ハイキングコースを{確認|かくにん}した。
examples.english: I checked the hiking course by looking at the map on the information board.

notes:
A compound of {案内|あんない} (guidance/information) + {板|ばん} (board/panel). These boards are ubiquitous in Japan, found at train stations, tourist attractions, parks, shopping malls, and building lobbies. They often include detailed maps with current-location markers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}を{見|み}る: to look at the information board
- {案内|あんない}{板|ばん}を{設置|せっち}する: to install an information board
- {観光|かんこう}{案内|あんない}{板|ばん}: tourist information board
- {電子|でんし}{案内|あんない}{板|ばん}: electronic information display

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {案内|あんない}{図|ず}: information map/diagram — a printed map rather than a board
- {看板|かんばん}: sign/signboard — more general, includes shop signs and billboards
- {掲示板|けいじばん}: bulletin board — for posted notices, not directional guidance
